title: Recover supported work from preemptible capacity
goal: Checkpoint eligible managed jobs and resume them after eviction under fencing and retry policy; non-checkpointable jobs report interruption and all duplicate compute is included in cost accounting. Deps (vectors): VC-201-023, VC-201-030, VC-201-055. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_057_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
